# Vendored third-party assets

Kept local so the site makes **zero third-party requests**.

| Path | What | License |
|---|---|---|
| `tailwindcss/tailwind.js` | Tailwind CSS Play CDN build (browser JIT compiler) | [MIT](https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/blob/main/LICENSE) |

To refresh: `curl -sL https://cdn.tailwindcss.com -o docs/vendor/tailwindcss/tailwind.js`
